articles.summary: Business Wire: Cloudflare Acquires Astro to Accelerate the Future of High-Performance Web Development. SAN FRANCISCO, January 16, 2026--Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE: NET) announced that The Astro Technology Company team, the creators of the Astro web framework, will be joining Cloudflare. Related tickers mentioned: NET, UL.
